title: Design-Grade Map admin page + DesignGradeMapForm (F-006)
scope: Page lists mappings (with design_name + grade_code resolved); fetches designs + grades for dropdowns; opens MasterFormDialog with DesignGradeMapForm. Surfaces 409 toast on duplicate (design_id, grade_id) (AC-016 client). Form has two shadcn Select dropdowns (design, grade) wired via react-hook-form Controller with zodResolver(designGradeMapSchema).

success_criteria.manual: Create duplicate pair -> red toast; submit empty -> two inline errors.
success_criteria.automated: TC-045 (toast on 409), TC-046 (form blocks when either dropdown empty).
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Page renders DesignGradeMap list with resolved names; form uses Controller for selects; only is_active rows appear in dropdowns.

checkout_prompt: 'Design-Grade Map admin — page + Select-based form; 409 toast (AC-016 client).'
